transcript: Speaker A: रात 10:00 बजे से सुबह 6:00 बजे तक गेट पर बैठता हूं। 8 घंटे कोई नहीं आता, कोई नहीं जाता। एक दिन एक लड़के ने बोला, 'अंकल, ये 8 घंटे बर्बाद मत करो, इंग्लिश सीखो।' उस रात से सब बदल गया। [I sit at the gate from 10 PM to 6 AM. For 8 hours, no one comes or goes. One day a boy said, 'Uncle, don't waste these 8 hours, learn English.' From that night, everything changed.]
summary: An animated story of Om Prakash, a 55-year-old security guard earning 8,000 rupees, who is advised by a resident to utilize his 8-hour night shift to learn English. Using the 'English Seekho' app, he improves his skills, passes a corporate interview, and secures a job paying 22,000 rupees, enabling him to fund his daughter's wedding. The ad encourages viewers to download the app to transform their lives.
